info.timeAllocation: 45h (60 sessions) contact hours + 1h final exam + 104h self-study
info.description: This comprehensive course on Embedded Systems with the S32K144 microcontroller offers a structured journey from foundational concepts to advanced practical applications, tailored for students, engineers, and enthusiasts interested in automotive and real-time embedded technologies. Spanning 20 sessions, the program begins with an overview of embedded systems history, classification, and the S32K144's architecture (based on ARM Cortex-M4), emphasizing its role in automotive applications like ECUs, body control, and powertrain systems. It progresses through key topics such as memory organization, clock management, GPIO, timers, interrupts, pin configuration, debugging, and optimization for performance and power efficiency. Theoretical sessions are complemented by hands-on practical labs, where students implement concepts using tools like S32 Design Studio and SDK. The course culminates in a group project presentation, fostering teamwork and real-world problem-solving skills. By the end, participants will be equipped to design, develop, and optimize embedded systems for constrained environments, with a strong focus on automotive standards, energy efficiency, and reliability.
info.studentTasks:
- Students must attend at least 80% of contact slots in order to be accepted to the final examination.
- Student is responsible to do all exercises, assignments and labs given by instructor in class or at home and submit on time.

Promptly access to the FU FLM at https://flm.fpt.edu.vn/ for up-to-date course information.

clos.loDetails: Explain the fundamentals and architecture of embedded systems (S32K144).
Use development tools to configure and program microcontroller resources.
Implement embedded system functions using microcontroller peripherals.
Debug and test embedded software to ensure correct functionality.
Optimize embedded software for performance and resource efficiency.
Apply embedded system concepts to develop, document, and present a functional project.

Chapter 1: Introduction to Embedded Systems and the S32K144 Microcontroller
Part 1: Introduction to Embedded Systems and Overview of S32K144
- Definitions of embedded systems, including real-time constraints and hardware-software integration.
- Key characteristics such as resource limitations, determinism, and reliability in harsh environments.
- Overview of S32K144 microcontroller, focusing on ARM Cortex-M4 core for 32-bit processing and DSP capabilities.
